name: ryanchoi-private
description: ryanchoi's private Claude Code plugin collection — plugins not (yet) ready or intended for public sharing.

plugins.name: blog-content-pipeline
plugins.description: Constitution-driven, approval-gated content pipeline for niche blogs: trend research -> SERP gap analysis -> idea refinement -> fact enrichment -> outline -> asset/metadata -> draft -> SEO vetting -> knowledge capture.

plugins.name: community-post-kit
plugins.description: Voice-driven, approval-gated drafting kit for maker-community posts (Disquiet, Indie Hackers, and other platforms) built from a product's own update notes, with frontmatter-based publish-status tracking.

plugins.name: gh-issue-flow
plugins.description: GitHub issue/PR lifecycle kit built on gh cli: create a well-formed issue from a rough description, pick the next issue to work on (with a worktree started for it), and merge an open PR (CI check, merge, worktree/branch cleanup).
